C-34.IntentSummary: R2.1 resilient Mermaid render pipeline in muya: SVG cache keyed by code+theme hash (no re-render of unchanged diagrams), keep the last good diagram on a syntax error and show mermaid's error message under it, debounce re-renders while typing (~250 ms), and render at natural size with horizontal scroll instead of squeezing wide diagrams into the text column. Delegated to a ZCode agent; reviewed and merged by the orchestrator.

T-001.Title: R2.1 render pipeline: cache, keep-last-good + error text, debounce, natural size

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Unchanged diagrams are not re-rendered on unrelated edits (cache hit by hash of code + theme); a theme switch re-renders.
A syntax error keeps the previous SVG visible and shows mermaid's own error text beneath it (escaped, no HTML injection); a diagram that never rendered shows the error text alone.
Typing in a diagram re-renders at most once per ~250 ms of quiet.
Wide diagrams keep their natural size inside a horizontally scrollable container (mermaid useMaxWidth disabled for flowcharts/sequence etc.); narrow diagrams look as before.
The WKWebView CSP style-hoisting behaviour is preserved; log markers [Muya][renderMermaid][BLOCK_MERMAID_…] on cache hit / render / error.
Unit tests for cache, keep-last-good, error escaping and debounce; e2e mermaid-render.spec.ts extended (wide diagram scrolls, syntax error keeps the last diagram).

Verification.Command: npm run build && npx playwright test --project=chromium tests/e2e/mermaid-render.spec.ts
